nodes.objective:
Implement TASK-0092 acceptance criteria. 1) Add
contracts/schemas/boundary-contract.schema.json defining the five
typed entry kinds (must, must_not, completion_signal, free_zone,
open_question) with required unique entry IDs, plus an example
record examples/records/boundary-contract.json that validates
against it. Do NOT edit scripts/lint_contracts.py or anything under
scripts/ -- that path is outside your write boundary; the trusted
maintainer registers the schema/example in the linter after this
node completes. 2) Add
src/ahra/boundary_contract.py with frozen domain objects that parse
and validate a boundary contract; freeze validation must reject
contracts containing open_question entries, duplicate entry IDs, or
unknown kinds; cover with tests/test_boundary_contract.py. 3) In
src/ahra/alignment_session.py, make the Human Gate 1 freeze path
record the typed boundary contract and its sha256 digest in the
immutable session snapshot, keeping the prose requirement as trace
only; cover with tests/test_alignment_session.py. Run
uv run python -B scripts/check.py and record it in
WorkReport.verification_commands_run.
Verify the boundary-contract schema, domain objects, and Gate 1 freeze semantics are present and consistent.

spec.rationale:
Workflow A v2, step 1 of 3 (ADR-0010). Per work/tasks/TASK-0092/task.md:
Human Gate 1 must freeze a typed boundary contract (must / must_not /
completion_signal / free_zone / open_question entries with unique IDs)
instead of prose. Declared filesystem.write resources are the
request-scoped allowlist.
